locations.note: Mata Hari arrives in 1905 to dance her way into Paris society, and later photographs the British ambassador's papers at the embassy for French counter-intelligence.
Her German handler Major von Kalle sets her on the Jules Verne weapons project; she steals aircraft designs and sabotages engines.
Monaco is her playground between assignments, reached by train and used to play the two sides against each other.
A 1912 chapter takes the double game to Madrid, on the trail of the German code wheel and its coded messages.
